items.hed: The Texans' Sunday opponent, Baltimore, enters Week 12 banged up — running back Derrick Henry is dealing with a concussion and wide receiver Zay Flowers an ankle injury, according to the Ravens' Wednesday injury report carried on the Texans' own site ahead of the Nov. 29 matchup at NRG Stadium
items.insight: The Ravens' Wednesday practice report lists Henry (concussion) and Flowers (ankle) as limited participants, along with wide receiver Rashod Bateman (groin) and linebacker Mike Green (knee) in limited work, while defensive end Calais Campbell (ribs/rest) and defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) did not practice. None of the listed players carry a game-status designation yet as of Wednesday's report; full Thursday and Friday participation will determine who is cleared for Sunday's Week 12 game at NRG Stadium.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium (formerly Reliant Stadium), Houston. Venue still.

items.hed: New Astros general manager Randy Flores has begun reshaping a Houston outfield that posted the majors' second-worst OPS last season, outrighting Joey Loperfido and non-tendering Taylor Trammell this past week as his first moves toward an upgrade
items.insight: MLB.com reports the Astros' outfield produced a .662 OPS last season, ranking 29th out of 30 teams, and that Flores has started addressing it by outrighting Loperfido and non-tendering Trammell, clearing roster space as the offseason's bigger outfield additions are still to come. The moves follow last week's hires of Brad Ausmus as manager and a new coaching staff that now includes J.P. Martinez at pitching coach, Aaron Bates at hitting coach and Nate Irving as assistant hitting coach.
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Houston Rockets beat the Phoenix Suns 116-104 at Toyota Center on Nov. 25 in NBA Cup group play, with Kevin Durant scoring a season-high 32 points to extend a five-game homestand
items.insight: NBA.com's game recap shows the Rockets closed the first half on a 12-5 run to take a 66-56 lead into the break and never relinquished it, while Phoenix shot just 1 of its last 24 three-point attempts in a cold night from deep. Devin Booker led the Suns with 25 points. Durant's 32 marked a season high as Houston continues its homestand at Toyota Center, with full box score and schedule detail on the league's official game page.
